name: waterkin_shaman_survives_the_cleanup_step_damage_and_the_bonus_end_together
notes: Printed: '... this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' A flier enters (the Shaman is 3/2) and the opponent's Pinger deals it 1 damage: not lethal at toughness 2. In the cleanup step damage wears off and 'until end of turn' effects end at the same time (CR 514.2), so the Shaman, a 2/1 again, has no damage left and survives. It is on the battlefield, 2/1, with no damage marked.
